name: Ma 2019 Cryogenics 104 design point 100 mW@4.5 K

reference.citation: Ma Y, Quan J, Wang J, et al. Development of a space 100 mW@5 K closed loop JT cooler. Cryogenics 104 (2019) 102983
reference.location: Table 1 design values (100/15 K precool, 2.0 MPa/0.13 MPa, 10.5 mg/s, 350 and 260 mW precooling, 100 mW @ 4.5 K)
reference.note: eta = 0.97 is the paper's lower bound ('not lower than 0.97'), not a measured value. Compare the PHEX loads with the design precooling powers. Sensitivity: Q_C = 90.2 mW at eta = 0.97, 108.8 mW at eta = 1; the paper's 100 mW design sits between (about eta = 0.985).
